Upper 25–30 percent should be visually quiet so the separately typeset headline can be placed there; stage the actual objects and people prominently in the remaining area. Cobalt-blue details connect the brand while other scene colors remain natural. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, readable receipts, signage, A/B/C graphics, infographic panels, price typography, or actual app screenshots. Unbranded screens and tags remain blank. Fictional illustrative art, not a real merchant photo or testimonial.
Style: Handcrafted clay and stop-motion visual style with rounded tactile objects, subtle handmade imperfections, thoughtful lighting and clear staging.
Color direction: cobalt, lavender, cream.
Specific scene: Conceptual handcrafted clay still life: a small member wallet with several plain blue round tokens, some tokens exchanged for a real cup of coffee, remaining tokens still clearly in the wallet. Human hands only, friendly shop counter, three-quarter close view, tactile wallet and ceramic cup. Show unused prepaid rights without charts, numbers or writing.
